request_payload.title: Germline CBL mutations cause developmental abnormalities and predispose to juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

mentions.sentence: We describe a dominant developmental disorder resulting from germline missense CBL mutations, which is characterized by impaired growth, developmental delay, cryptorchidism and a predisposition to juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML).
